text: Odile Ferrant opened Saltmarsh & Rye in Port Vey on Tuesday, adding a 42-seat dining room to a waterfront block that had been vacant for 18 months. The chef, previously executive at Brine House, said the new venue will run a 14-dish menu centered on cured fish, heritage grains, and sourdough baked on-site. Opening-night checks averaged 38 credits per head, with 31 covers served by 9:30 p.m. Ferrant has hired 12 staff and signed a two-year lease with landlord Clove Quay Properties. For the sector, the launch signals continued demand for chef-led neighborhood restaurants that can pair premium pricing with tight labor costs and local supply chains.
